name: YINSON
recent: Yinson 近期成为市场焦点，相关公告与新闻持续更新。同时，雇员公积金局（EPF）与退休基金局（KWAP）等主要股东近期持续申报股权变动。公司最新季度营收同比下滑 16.7%，但净利同比增长 26.7%。
notable: 相关要约文件与公告持续更新。
Yinson 表示尚未接受该私有化方案。
公司董事及高管因 2026 年 RSU 计划获配普通股，涉及集团执行主席、首席执行官等。
risks: 私有化方案仍需股东表决，结果存在不确定性。
主要股东 EPF 与 KWAP 近期多次申报股权变动，显示股权结构持续变化。
最新季度营收同比下滑 16.7%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度，营收为 MYR 11.36 亿，环比增长 8.3%，但同比下滑 16.7%；净利为 MYR 1.28 亿，环比增长 6.7%，同比增长 26.7%，净利率为 11.3%。

recent_en: Yinson has been in focus following MISC's proposed takeover and privatisation offer, with ongoing announcements and news updates. Meanwhile, major shareholders such as EPF and KWAP have been actively reporting changes in their shareholdings. The company's latest quarterly revenue fell 16.7% year-on-year, while net profit rose 26.7% year-on-year.
notable_en: MISC has made a conditional voluntary takeover offer to privatise Yinson, with ongoing offer documents and announcements.
Yinson stated that it has not accepted the proposed privatisation scheme.
Directors and senior management, including the Group Executive Chairman and Group CEO, received ordinary shares under the 2026 RSU plan.
risks_en: The privatisation scheme remains subject to shareholder approval and the outcome is uncertain.
Major shareholders EPF and KWAP have made multiple shareholding change filings recently, indicating ongoing changes in the shareholding structure.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 1.136 billion, up 8.3% QoQ but down 16.7% YoY; net profit was MYR 128 million, up 6.7% QoQ and 26.7% YoY, with a net margin of 11.3%.
